observation.limitations: No live weighted-allocation dataset collected. Initial synthetic tests do not establish real workload quality, billing, cost savings or live Desktop activation.

previousReview: Issue #332 workflow pilot and #333 high-cost requirements; prior category policy used unconditional continuity.
findings: Unconditional continuity prevents allocation opportunities. Hard-prioritizing unmarked peers nearly excludes high-cost candidates; extreme-only gating wrongly couples cost to difficulty.
decision: Implement positive main-turn weights ordinary=1, marked=0.2 and finite previous-model multiplier=1.5 within the fitting supplier category. Capture local bounded opportunities and expected shares. Defer advisor calls until public evidence/authorization/account seams pass their own acceptance.
validation: 342 focused tests and 19 focused tooling tests passed with a supplemental unchanged pinned resolver. Native Client/Host gateways and SettingsForms fiber/restart persistence included. Synthetic source-component browser checks passed at widths 1280/390/195 in both themes. Normal pnpm verify blocked by configured mirror HTTP 404 for exact rc.2 dependency; full required CI, build, tarball and publication remain pending. This is not live Desktop/model/billing evidence.

followUp.owner: Maintainer or Agent assigned to post-delivery review issue #334
followUp.trigger: Before the next policy change, or after at least 200 eligible opportunities per compared model across at least 20 Sessions, keeping policy/candidate-set windows separate
followUp.metric: Opportunity-adjusted actual versus expected selections, marked replacement/retention, within-pool switching, assessment latency/failures; outcomes and costs only when independently attributable
followUp.action: Review local sanitized aggregates, check missing/evicted coverage, and retain/change/defer with reasons. This threshold is not statistical significance. No automatic upload, quality inference from completion, or credit inference from balance deltas.
